set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 4. Implement one explicit DCT/Haar-to-LNA binding that lowers typed logical slots to payload plans over the current store, produces an archived ResponseSource, and provides an ArchiveWritePlan and write receipt. Phase-0 canonical-value and receipt decisions are inputs, not choices inside this slice. Acceptance: memory and LNA selected blocks agree under DecodeConsistency; archive round trip preserves representation model and raw logical payload scalar bits unless an admitted profile declares normalization; external dependencies are content-verified; whole-payload fallback is receipted honestly; injected failure after every proper write-plan prefix yields absent, Staging, or Incomplete, never Published; mathematical code imports no LNA/HDF5 types; the frozen numerical corpus remains green.
